newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti stock suspended, news conf called.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti stock suspended, news conf called.

text.p: All shares in Italian information technology group Olivetti were suspended on the Milan stock market for today pending an announcement, stock market authority Consob said.
In statement from Olivetti moments later said the group had called a news conference at 1600 GMT on Monday in Milan.
Olivetti said the news conference was for "an important announcement" and it had asked Consob to suspend its shares.

Reason for the news conference was not given but there has been heavy speculation in the stock market in recent weeks that Olivetti is on the verge of selling its loss-making personal computers division.
There were also rumours in recent days that Olivetti was planning a more far-reaching restructuring.
